# arXiv search fixture — provenance

`arxiv_search_atom.xml` is an **observed, verbatim** capture. Nothing in it was
edited, trimmed or invented.

- Captured: 2026-09-19
- Endpoint: `https://export.arxiv.org/api/query`
- Parameters: `search_query=all:"mean reversion" AND all:"exit"`, `max_results=3`,
  `sortBy=relevance`
- Query expression produced by `build_arxiv_query()` for `RQ-6d9c12f4`, so the
  fixture exercises the real transformation rather than a hand-picked query.

The entry identifiers carry real version suffixes (`v3`, `v4`, `v1`). That is
why the file is useful: version stripping and canonicalization are tested
against identifiers arXiv actually served, not against a form invented to make
the test pass.

Do not edit this file to satisfy a later gate. If a test needs different data,
add an explicitly synthetic fixture next to it and label it, the way
`README_agent_reach_doctor.md` describes — an unrealistic fixture that agrees
with the code and disagrees with reality is what concealed a real defect for an
entire gate.
